answer: Each identity locks 70 credits in the canyon registry, and the kernel issues one plume receipt tied to its key, funding source, and work sample. The kernel checks each against all prior ones; a shared key, source, or copied sample links the pair and slashes both bonds. A fake costs 95, and the k-th fake costs 95 plus 5 times (k minus 1), because it must differ from all earlier fakes. For 1,000 fakes that totals 2,592,500 credits. A rented funding ring fails because its shared source links several receipts, which the kernel then burns. An honest agent pays 70 once, refunded after one epoch.
